content_html_sanitized:
Posted November 21, 2002
Special to MarijuanaNews

Yesterday DEAland Drug Czar John Walters descended on Vancouver. Someone had invited him to speak to the Vancouver Board of Trade, a local business group.
See
 Walters Concedes That Canada Can Legalize Cannabis If It Wants To, Which Was The Only True Thing He Said While In Montreal.

Among his more bizarre lies was a new entry in the BC Bud line: He said 95 percent is exported to DEAland! Of course, there is absolutely no data to support that claim. Seizures at the Canadian border are just one percent of the total seized at the Mexican border.
See
 How Marijuana Prohibition Really Works on the Texas/Mexico Border. Contrast with the Situation at the Canadian Border. Great Journalism.

With exquisitely bad timing, Walters visit came just a few days after anti-prohibitionists swept the Vancouver city elections. The outgoing Mayor had become an anti-prohibitionist over the last several years, and even complained to the DEAland embassy in Ottawa about the Walters visit!
See
 Marijuana Legalization, The Missing Pillar in Solving the Substance Abuse Problem in Vancouver and All of Canada. Analysis By Richard Cowan

The new Mayor is even more anti-prohibitionist, but also now has the support of the city council. I hope to write more about this election soon, because it is a really important development.

Meanwhile, when Steve Tuck heard that Walters was going to be speaking here, he and several friends picketed the hotel venue.

They also passed out several hundred copies I had printed of Dan Forbes Slate article about Walters lying about potent pot.
See
 Dan Forbes Documents Walters Lies About Potency. Understanding That The War On Cannabis Is Built On Lies Is Key to Understanding More Than Just Drug War.

While they were protesting, Steve and others were interviewed by various Canadian media, and a long interview with Steve ran on last night's CBC evening news program, Canada Today.

So at the end of a long and productive day, Steve went to celebrate at the New Amsterdam café, a Hastings Street smoke-easy where smoking but not sales is tolerated. It is just three doors down from the more famous Blunt Bros. It draws an older crowd, and last night was folk music night. All so terribly respectable.

However, when a large group of men in black came sweeping into the place just before closing time, it was a bit much for the manager. He was about to ask them to leave when Steve recognized John Walters! The DEAland Drug Czar had come to a real Vansterdam marijuana den to watch the addicts kill and eat one another, or something.

While it is impossible to know what someone who lives in Walters world really knows, he seemed to recognize Steve, and immediately walked up to him, but said nothing.

For obvious reasons, the crowd was not too friendly, but in another twist, Steve found himself urging everyone to be nice to the man who wants to kill him. So everyone cooled it, and the Czar was politely tolerated as Steve stood next to him and continued smoking his medical hash, with his stash in plain sight!

Walters group consisted of several DEAland narks and/or Secret Service agents and the head of Vancouver's narcotics squad, Kash Heed. (That is really his name.)

But Heed is not a party line prohibitionist, and is responsible for the city's de facto decriminalization of possession of all illicit drugs. Several times Steve overheard him ask Walters, What is the harm in this?

Walters had no response. He was probably trying to figure out what lie to tell about the peaceful scene before him. Walters personifies the banality of evil.
See
 The Washington Post and The Evil of Banality. " Only the hypocrite is really rotten to the core.

Or maybe he had just gotten a contact high from the thick cloud of hash smoke.

In any case, Walters said nothing to anyone except Kash Heed and stayed for about fifteen minutes, and left.

There have been many truly bizarre scenes in this war, but it is hard to imagine anything weirder than the DEAland Drug Czar in the peaceful surroundings of a Vansterdam smoke-easy, standing next to a person he wants to torture to death.

Steve Tuck is a hero in my eyes because I have seen the sacrifices he has made for the cause of freedom and the pain that he has had to endure. But last night he showed an evil man how a real gentleman acts. That is the contact high that John Walters really needs.
See
 The Steven Tuck Defense Fund. He Must Be Not Abandoned By This Movement, Or The Movement Is Morally Bankrupt.
